children: New Delhi, Oct. 21 -- The Q2 earnings season for the financial year 2026-27 (Q2 FY27) will continue on Wednesday, October 21, with 38 companies set to release their financial results for the July-September quarter.

Among the prominent companies scheduled to report their quarterly earnings today are Eternal, Adani Green Energy, Indian Hotels Company, SRF, Vishal Mega Mart, KEI Industries, Mahindra and Mahindra Financial Services, and PC Jeweller.

Investors will monitor these companies' quarterly performance, focusing on revenue growth, net profit, operating margins and management commentary for insights into their business outlook and growth prospects.

According to Seema Srivastava, Senior Research Analyst at SMC Global Securities, Blinkit's aggressive dark-store expansion, robust gross order value (GOV) acceleration, and improving operational metrics continue to command market attention, while core food delivery demonstrates steady, resilient execution.

Srivastava further added that ahead of the earnings announcement, market participants should closely evaluate unit economics, dark-store maturation rates, contribution margins, and management commentary regarding intensifying competition in the quick-commerce landscape.

Meanwhile, brokerage firm JM Financial forecasted Zomato's food delivery business to grow its net order value (NOV) by around 21% year-on-year (YoY) and 6.2% quarter-on-quarter (QoQ) in the November period. This would be faster than the 20% growth recorded in Q1FY27. The growth is expected to be supported by an increase in monthly transacting users (MTUs) to 28.1 million, compared with 27.2 million in Q1FY27 and 24.1 million in Q2FY26.

The company's take rate, which is the share of NOV it earns as revenue, is expected to rise by 2.5 percentage points year-on-year and 0.04 percentage points quarter-on-quarter to 32.9%. This improvement, along with higher order values, could help Zomato's adjusted revenue grow by 31% year-on-year and 6% quarter-on-quarter.
JM Financial anticipated that Tata Group company's revenue to grow 18% year-on-year (YoY) and EBITDA to rise 20% in Q2FY27.
It further believes that standalone revenue per available room (RevPAR) is expected to increase by around 16% YoY, while consolidated domestic RevPAR growth is estimated at 13-14%.
Profit margins are expected to remain largely stable compared with both the same quarter last year and the previous quarter, it said.
